package dispatch_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	events "example.com/dispatch/gen/events"
	hcli "example.com/dispatch/gen/http/cli/dispatch"
	hc "example.com/dispatch/gen/http/events/client"
	hs "example.com/dispatch/gen/http/events/server"
	rcli "example.com/dispatch/gen/jsonrpc/cli/dispatch"
	rc "example.com/dispatch/gen/jsonrpc/rpcevents/client"
	rs "example.com/dispatch/gen/jsonrpc/rpcevents/server"
	rpc "example.com/dispatch/gen/rpcevents"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	contextKey  struct{}
	valueAccess interface {
		Value() string
		SetValue(string)
	}
	auditState struct {
		t                 *testing.T
		ctx               context.Context
		opening, messages []string
		short             loom.Endpoint
	}
)

func (a *auditState) open(ctx context.Context, label string, req any, next loom.Endpoint, value valueAccess) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, a.ctx.Value(contextKey{}), ctx.Value(contextKey{}))
	a.opening = append(a.opening, label)
	if value != nil {
		value.SetValue(value.Value() + ":" + label)
	}
	if a.short != nil {
		return a.short(ctx, req)
	}
	return next(ctx, req)
}
func (a *auditState) receive(ctx context.Context, label string, next loom.Endpoint, access func(any) valueAccess) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, a.ctx.Value(contextKey{}), ctx.Value(contextKey{}))
	a.messages = append(a.messages, label)
	res, err := next(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return res, err
	}
	value := access(res)
	value.SetValue(value.Value() + ":" + label)
	return res, nil
}

type httpAudit struct {
	*auditState
}

func (a httpAudit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *events.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorStreamingRecv, i.CallType())
	return a.receive(ctx, "audit", next, func(v any) valueAccess {
		return i.ClientStreamingResult(v)
	})
}
func (a httpAudit) Both(ctx context.Context, i *events.BothInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	if i.CallType() == loom.InterceptorUnary {
		return a.open(ctx, "both", i.RawPayload(), next, i.Payload())
	}
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorStreamingRecv, i.CallType())
	return a.receive(ctx, "both", next, func(v any) valueAccess {
		return i.ClientStreamingResult(v)
	})
}
func (a httpAudit) Payload(ctx context.Context, i *events.PayloadInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorUnary, i.CallType())
	return a.open(ctx, "payload", i.RawPayload(), next, i.Payload())
}
func (a httpAudit) Generic(ctx context.Context, i *events.GenericInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorUnary, i.CallType())
	return a.open(ctx, "generic", i.RawPayload(), next, nil)
}

type httpStream struct {
	ctx           context.Context
	seen          context.Context
	count, closed int
	failure       error
}

func (s *httpStream) Recv() (*events.Chunk, error) {
	return s.RecvWithContext(s.ctx)
}
func (s *httpStream) RecvWithContext(ctx context.Context) (*events.Chunk, error) {
	s.seen = ctx
	if s.failure != nil {
		return nil, s.failure
	}
	if s.count > 0 {
		return nil, io.EOF
	}
	s.count++
	return &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}, nil
}
func (s *httpStream) Close() error {
	s.closed++
	return nil
}
func httpClient(unary, stream loom.Endpoint, audit events.ClientInterceptors) *events.Client {
	return events.NewClient(unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, audit)
}
func TestHTTPProfiles(t *testing.T) {
	for _, enabled := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, profile := range []struct {
			name            string
			opens, messages []string
			payload, result string
		}{
			{"StreamOnly", nil, []string{"audit"}, "request", "wire:audit"},
			{"Combined", []string{"both"}, []string{"both"}, "request:both", "wire:both"},
			{"PayloadOnly", []string{"payload"}, nil, "request:payload", "wire"},
			{"Generic", []string{"generic"}, nil, "request", "wire"},
			{"Ordered", []string{"payload", "generic", "both"}, []string{"both", "audit"}, "request:payload:both", "wire:audit:both"},
			{"Plain", nil, nil, "request", "wire"},
		} {
			t.Run(profile.name+map[bool]string{false: "/nil", true: "/intercepted"}[enabled], func(t *testing.T) {
				ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "opening")
				state := &auditState{t: t, ctx: ctx}
				var audit events.ClientInterceptors
				if enabled {
					audit = httpAudit{state}
				}
				calls := 0
				seen := ""
				unary := loom.Endpoint(func(ctx context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
					calls++
					seen = req.(*events.Request).Value
					return &events.Summary{Value: "ordinary"}, nil
				})
				stub := &httpStream{ctx: ctx}
				opening := loom.Endpoint(func(ctx context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
					calls++
					seen = req.(*events.Request).Value
					return stub, nil
				})
				client := httpClient(unary, opening, audit)
				unaryCalls := map[string]func(context.Context, *events.Request) (*events.Summary, error){"StreamOnly": client.StreamOnly, "Combined": client.Combined, "PayloadOnly": client.PayloadOnly, "Generic": client.Generic, "Ordered": client.Ordered, "Plain": client.Plain}
				var value *events.Summary
				var err error
				require.NotPanics(t, func() {
					value, err = unaryCalls[profile.name](ctx, &events.Request{Value: "request"})
				})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, "ordinary", value.Value)
				require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
				expectedOpening := profile.opens
				expectedMessages := profile.messages
				expectedPayload, expectedResult := profile.payload, profile.result
				if !enabled {
					expectedOpening, expectedMessages = nil, nil
					expectedPayload, expectedResult = "request", "wire"
				}
				require.Equal(t, expectedOpening, state.opening)
				require.Empty(t, state.messages)
				require.Equal(t, expectedPayload, seen)
				state.opening = nil
				type streamContract interface {
					Recv() (*events.Chunk, error)
					RecvWithContext(context.Context) (*events.Chunk, error)
					Close() error
				}
				streamCalls := map[string]func(context.Context, *events.Request) (streamContract, error){"StreamOnly": func(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.StreamOnlyStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Combined": func(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.CombinedStream(ctx, p)
				}, "PayloadOnly": func(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.PayloadOnlyStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Generic": func(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.GenericStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Ordered": func(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.OrderedStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Plain": func(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.PlainStream(ctx, p)
				}}
				stream, err := streamCalls[profile.name](ctx, &events.Request{Value: "request"})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, 2, calls)
				require.Equal(t, expectedOpening, state.opening)
				require.Empty(t, state.messages)
				require.Equal(t, expectedPayload, seen)
				chunk, err := stream.Recv()
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, expectedResult, chunk.Value)
				require.Same(t, ctx, stub.seen)
				require.Equal(t, expectedMessages, state.messages)
				state.messages = nil
				other := context.WithValue(ctx, contextKey{}, "operation")
				state.ctx = other
				stub.count = 0
				chunk, err = stream.RecvWithContext(other)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, expectedResult, chunk.Value)
				require.Same(t, other, stub.seen)
				sentinel := errors.New("receive")
				stub.failure = sentinel
				_, err = stream.RecvWithContext(other)
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
				stub.failure = nil
				_, err = stream.RecvWithContext(other)
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
				callbacks := len(state.messages)
				require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
				require.Len(t, state.messages, callbacks, "cleanup is not a message callback")
				require.Equal(t, 1, stub.closed)
			})
		}
	}
}
func TestHTTPOpenFailureAndShortCircuit(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "opening")
	for _, fail := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, short := range []bool{false, true} {
			state := &auditState{t: t, ctx: ctx}
			sentinel := errors.New("opening")
			calls := 0
			endpoint := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
				calls++
				return nil, errors.New("unexpected endpoint call")
			})
			for _, streamRole := range []bool{false, true} {
				state.opening = nil
				target := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
					if fail {
						return nil, sentinel
					}
					if streamRole {
						return &httpStream{ctx: ctx}, nil
					}
					return &events.Summary{Value: "short"}, nil
				})
				actual := target
				if short {
					state.short = target
					actual = endpoint
				}
				client := httpClient(actual, actual, httpAudit{state})
				if streamRole {
					stream, err := client.CombinedStream(ctx, &events.Request{Value: "request"})
					if fail {
						require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
					} else {
						require.NoError(t, err)
						require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
					}
				} else {
					value, err := client.Combined(ctx, &events.Request{Value: "request"})
					if fail {
						require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
					} else {
						require.NoError(t, err)
						require.Equal(t, "short", value.Value)
					}
				}
				require.Equal(t, []string{"both"}, state.opening)
				require.Empty(t, state.messages)
			}
			require.Zero(t, calls)
		}
	}
}

type httpService struct{}

func (httpService) StreamOnly(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request, s events.StreamOnlyServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, nil
	}
	if err := s.SendWithContext(ctx, &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, s.Close()
}
func (httpService) Combined(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request, s events.CombinedServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, nil
	}
	if err := s.SendWithContext(ctx, &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, s.Close()
}
func (httpService) PayloadOnly(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request, s events.PayloadOnlyServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, nil
	}
	if err := s.SendWithContext(ctx, &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, s.Close()
}
func (httpService) Generic(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request, s events.GenericServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, nil
	}
	if err := s.SendWithContext(ctx, &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, s.Close()
}
func (httpService) Ordered(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request, s events.OrderedServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, nil
	}
	if err := s.SendWithContext(ctx, &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, s.Close()
}
func (httpService) Plain(ctx context.Context, p *events.Request, s events.PlainServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, nil
	}
	if err := s.SendWithContext(ctx, &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &events.Summary{Value: p.Value}, s.Close()
}

func TestHTTPMountedAndCLI(t *testing.T) {
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	hs.Mount(mux, hs.New(events.NewEndpoints(httpService{}), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer srv.Close()
	host := strings.TrimPrefix(srv.URL, "http://")
	transport := hc.NewClient("http", host, srv.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "mounted"), 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	state := &auditState{t: t, ctx: ctx}
	audit := httpAudit{state}
	client := httpClient(transport.Combined(), transport.CombinedStream(), audit)
	value, err := client.Combined(ctx, &events.Request{Value: "request"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "request:both", value.Value)
	stream, err := client.CombinedStream(ctx, &events.Request{ID: new("one"), Value: "request"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	chunk, err := stream.Recv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "wire:both", chunk.Value)
	_, err = stream.Recv()
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
	require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
	early, err := client.CombinedStream(ctx, &events.Request{ID: new("early"), Value: "request"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, early.Close())
	original := os.Args
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		os.Args = original
	})
	for _, method := range []string{"stream-only", "combined"} {
		state.opening, state.messages = nil, nil
		os.Args = []string{"dispatch", "events", method, "--body", `{"id":"cli","value":"request"}`}
		endpoint, payload, err := hcli.ParseEndpoint("http", host, srv.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false, audit)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		result, err := endpoint(ctx, payload)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		value := result.(*events.Summary)
		expected := "request"
		if method == "combined" {
			expected += ":both"
		}
		require.Equal(t, expected, value.Value)
		require.Empty(t, state.messages)
	}
}

type rpcAudit struct {
	*auditState
}

func (a rpcAudit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *rpc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorStreamingRecv, i.CallType())
	return a.receive(ctx, "audit", next, func(v any) valueAccess {
		return i.ClientStreamingResult(v)
	})
}
func (a rpcAudit) Both(ctx context.Context, i *rpc.BothInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	if i.CallType() == loom.InterceptorUnary {
		return a.open(ctx, "both", i.RawPayload(), next, i.Payload())
	}
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorStreamingRecv, i.CallType())
	return a.receive(ctx, "both", next, func(v any) valueAccess {
		return i.ClientStreamingResult(v)
	})
}
func (a rpcAudit) Payload(ctx context.Context, i *rpc.PayloadInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorUnary, i.CallType())
	return a.open(ctx, "payload", i.RawPayload(), next, i.Payload())
}
func (a rpcAudit) Generic(ctx context.Context, i *rpc.GenericInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorUnary, i.CallType())
	return a.open(ctx, "generic", i.RawPayload(), next, nil)
}

type rpcStream struct {
	ctx           context.Context
	seen          context.Context
	count, closed int
	failure       error
}

func (s *rpcStream) Recv() (*rpc.Chunk, error) {
	return s.RecvWithContext(s.ctx)
}
func (s *rpcStream) RecvWithContext(ctx context.Context) (*rpc.Chunk, error) {
	s.seen = ctx
	if s.failure != nil {
		return nil, s.failure
	}
	if s.count > 0 {
		return nil, io.EOF
	}
	s.count++
	return &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"}, nil
}
func (s *rpcStream) Close() error {
	s.closed++
	return nil
}
func rpcClient(unary, stream loom.Endpoint, audit rpc.ClientInterceptors) *rpc.Client {
	return rpc.NewClient(unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, unary, stream, audit)
}
func TestRPCProfiles(t *testing.T) {
	for _, enabled := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, profile := range []struct {
			name            string
			opens, messages []string
			payload, result string
		}{
			{"StreamOnly", nil, []string{"audit"}, "request", "wire:audit"},
			{"Combined", []string{"both"}, []string{"both"}, "request:both", "wire:both"},
			{"PayloadOnly", []string{"payload"}, nil, "request:payload", "wire"},
			{"Generic", []string{"generic"}, nil, "request", "wire"},
			{"Ordered", []string{"payload", "generic", "both"}, []string{"both", "audit"}, "request:payload:both", "wire:audit:both"},
			{"Plain", nil, nil, "request", "wire"},
		} {
			t.Run(profile.name+map[bool]string{false: "/nil", true: "/intercepted"}[enabled], func(t *testing.T) {
				ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "opening")
				state := &auditState{t: t, ctx: ctx}
				var audit rpc.ClientInterceptors
				if enabled {
					audit = rpcAudit{state}
				}
				calls := 0
				seen := ""
				unary := loom.Endpoint(func(ctx context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
					calls++
					seen = req.(*rpc.Request).Value
					return &rpc.Summary{Value: "ordinary"}, nil
				})
				stub := &rpcStream{ctx: ctx}
				opening := loom.Endpoint(func(ctx context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
					calls++
					seen = req.(*rpc.Request).Value
					return stub, nil
				})
				client := rpcClient(unary, opening, audit)
				unaryCalls := map[string]func(context.Context, *rpc.Request) (*rpc.Summary, error){"StreamOnly": client.StreamOnly, "Combined": client.Combined, "PayloadOnly": client.PayloadOnly, "Generic": client.Generic, "Ordered": client.Ordered, "Plain": client.Plain}
				var value *rpc.Summary
				var err error
				require.NotPanics(t, func() {
					value, err = unaryCalls[profile.name](ctx, &rpc.Request{Value: "request"})
				})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, "ordinary", value.Value)
				require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
				expectedOpening := profile.opens
				expectedMessages := profile.messages
				expectedPayload, expectedResult := profile.payload, profile.result
				if !enabled {
					expectedOpening, expectedMessages = nil, nil
					expectedPayload, expectedResult = "request", "wire"
				}
				require.Equal(t, expectedOpening, state.opening)
				require.Empty(t, state.messages)
				require.Equal(t, expectedPayload, seen)
				state.opening = nil
				type streamContract interface {
					Recv() (*rpc.Chunk, error)
					RecvWithContext(context.Context) (*rpc.Chunk, error)
					Close() error
				}
				streamCalls := map[string]func(context.Context, *rpc.Request) (streamContract, error){"StreamOnly": func(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.StreamOnlyStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Combined": func(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.CombinedStream(ctx, p)
				}, "PayloadOnly": func(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.PayloadOnlyStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Generic": func(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.GenericStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Ordered": func(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.OrderedStream(ctx, p)
				}, "Plain": func(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request) (streamContract, error) {
					return client.PlainStream(ctx, p)
				}}
				stream, err := streamCalls[profile.name](ctx, &rpc.Request{Value: "request"})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, 2, calls)
				require.Equal(t, expectedOpening, state.opening)
				require.Empty(t, state.messages)
				require.Equal(t, expectedPayload, seen)
				chunk, err := stream.Recv()
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, expectedResult, chunk.Value)
				require.Same(t, ctx, stub.seen)
				require.Equal(t, expectedMessages, state.messages)
				state.messages = nil
				other := context.WithValue(ctx, contextKey{}, "operation")
				state.ctx = other
				stub.count = 0
				chunk, err = stream.RecvWithContext(other)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, expectedResult, chunk.Value)
				require.Same(t, other, stub.seen)
				sentinel := errors.New("receive")
				stub.failure = sentinel
				_, err = stream.RecvWithContext(other)
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
				stub.failure = nil
				_, err = stream.RecvWithContext(other)
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
				callbacks := len(state.messages)
				require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
				require.Len(t, state.messages, callbacks, "cleanup is not a message callback")
				require.Equal(t, 1, stub.closed)
			})
		}
	}
}
func TestRPCOpenFailureAndShortCircuit(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "opening")
	for _, fail := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, short := range []bool{false, true} {
			state := &auditState{t: t, ctx: ctx}
			sentinel := errors.New("opening")
			calls := 0
			endpoint := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
				calls++
				return nil, errors.New("unexpected endpoint call")
			})
			for _, streamRole := range []bool{false, true} {
				state.opening = nil
				target := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
					if fail {
						return nil, sentinel
					}
					if streamRole {
						return &rpcStream{ctx: ctx}, nil
					}
					return &rpc.Summary{Value: "short"}, nil
				})
				actual := target
				if short {
					state.short = target
					actual = endpoint
				}
				client := rpcClient(actual, actual, rpcAudit{state})
				if streamRole {
					stream, err := client.CombinedStream(ctx, &rpc.Request{Value: "request"})
					if fail {
						require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
					} else {
						require.NoError(t, err)
						require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
					}
				} else {
					value, err := client.Combined(ctx, &rpc.Request{Value: "request"})
					if fail {
						require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
					} else {
						require.NoError(t, err)
						require.Equal(t, "short", value.Value)
					}
				}
				require.Equal(t, []string{"both"}, state.opening)
				require.Empty(t, state.messages)
			}
			require.Zero(t, calls)
		}
	}
}

type rpcService struct{}

func (rpcService) StreamOnly(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request, s rpc.StreamOnlyServerStream) (*rpc.Summary, error) {
	return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"})
}
func (rpcService) Combined(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request, s rpc.CombinedServerStream) (*rpc.Summary, error) {
	return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"})
}
func (rpcService) PayloadOnly(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request, s rpc.PayloadOnlyServerStream) (*rpc.Summary, error) {
	return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"})
}
func (rpcService) Generic(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request, s rpc.GenericServerStream) (*rpc.Summary, error) {
	return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"})
}
func (rpcService) Ordered(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request, s rpc.OrderedServerStream) (*rpc.Summary, error) {
	return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"})
}
func (rpcService) Plain(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.Request, s rpc.PlainServerStream) (*rpc.Summary, error) {
	return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"})
}

func TestRPCMountedAndCLI(t *testing.T) {
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	rs.Mount(mux, rs.New(rpc.NewEndpoints(rpcService{}), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil))
	srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer srv.Close()
	host := strings.TrimPrefix(srv.URL, "http://")
	transport := rc.NewClient("http", host, srv.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "mounted"), 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	state := &auditState{t: t, ctx: ctx}
	audit := rpcAudit{state}
	client := rpcClient(transport.Combined(), transport.Combined(), audit)

	stream, err := client.CombinedStream(ctx, &rpc.Request{ID: new("one"), Value: "request"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	chunk, err := stream.Recv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "wire:both", chunk.Value)
	_, err = stream.Recv()
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
	require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
	early, err := client.CombinedStream(ctx, &rpc.Request{ID: new("early"), Value: "request"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, early.Close())
	original := os.Args
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		os.Args = original
	})
	for _, method := range []string{"stream-only", "combined"} {
		state.opening, state.messages = nil, nil
		os.Args = []string{"dispatch", "rpcevents", method, "--body", `{"id":"cli","value":"request"}`}
		endpoint, payload, err := rcli.ParseEndpoint("http", host, srv.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false, audit)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		result, err := endpoint(ctx, payload)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		stream := result.(interface {
			Recv() (*rpc.Chunk, error)
			Close() error
		})
		value, err := stream.Recv()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		expected := "wire:audit"
		if method == "combined" {
			expected = "wire:both"
		}
		require.Equal(t, expected, value.Value)
		require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
	}
}
